'''Mother Ves'ad''' was the name of the massive [[Queen/Legends|queen]] [[Spider/Legends|spider]] of the [[Wyyyschokk/Legends|wyyyschokk]], or webweavers, present in the [[Webweaver caverns]] of the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. [[Rhiek Okina]], a member of the [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts]] of the forest, hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill the gigantic spider. The spacer was successful and Okina rewarded them with a sinew-wrapped knife made from the remains of Ves'ad.
